notes.title: CleanFall EA Update#2 Beta Testing-The Legion and Energy Update Part 1
notes.content:
[p]Salutations denizens of the abyss![/p][p]    I'm happy to announce that CleanFall is a part of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025"]The Hungry Ghost Festival 2025[/url]. I have also released a new update to the unstable branch of the game. This content can be accessed in the same way as the nightmare mode play testing. Below are the changes:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Overview[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The consumer class can now employ an army of creatures that last forever and are controlled by holding the shift key.[/p][/*][*][p]The energizer can now equip “pocket weapons” that automatically attack out of the player’s inventory while firing a weapon[/p][/*][*][p]The new "reload cell" item allow energizers to store massive amounts of energy for pivotal fights.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets now show where their legs will go before you place the turret.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now move turrets with any F-tool by clicking left mouse button.[/p][/*][*][p]There is a new meta currency for unlocking new items and gear![/p][/*][*][p]There is a new meta unlock menu for unlocking new items to appear during runs.[/p][/*][*][p]New dedicated currency slots for ore and fiber.[/p][/*][*][p]New item banning system unlocked after reaching the Hollow.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now save and quit and resume your run later at the start of chapter 2.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New common item “Friendly Spider”.[/p][list][*][p]Can be found in burrows around the jungle for 2 fiber.[/p][/*][*][p]New consumer type summon weapon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]New “Saw Drone”[/p][list][*][p]Rare item crafted in jungle vending machines.[/p][/*][*][p]New consumer type summon weapon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New “Defense Drone factory”[/p][list][*][p]This new common item can be purchased for 2 ore.[/p][/*][*][p]Spawns a new drone that doesn’t follow the player, making it more effective for surviving invasions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New “Reload Cell”.[/p][list][*][p]Can be crafted at jungle vending machines for 2 fiber.[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically replenishes 65% of your max energy when you are very low on energy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New “pocket Pistol”[/p][list][*][p]This weapon automatically attacks out of your inventory whenever you are firing a weapon or charging your pulse rifle. It costs energy to fire, and it can be purchased out of jungle vending machines for 1 ore and 1 fiber.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Burrows spawn around the jungle. Feeding the inhabitants may prove useful.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets will now show where their legs will go before you place them.[/p][list][*][p]You can make a turret only grab player structures by holding the “alt” key.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The F-tool can now move turrets by holding left click. The turret grabber has been reworked.[/p][list][*][p]Mining a turret no longer redeploys its legs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Meta Currency has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now unlock additional items by spending meta currency at a new machine found in the Reaper’s Palace.[/p][/*][*][p]You now get an additional 2 inventory slots that can only carry ore and fiber.[/p][/*][*][p]Nukes are back, and more glorious than ever before.[/p][list][*][p]Nuke mining and damage size greatly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Nuke effects redone.[/p][/*][*][p]Nukes now leave radiation for 12 seconds that deals damage over time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Item banning system.[/p][list][*][p]As the item pool increases, you can ban more and more items, which should allow me to add many more items without the item pool becoming too diluted and difficult to find what you need.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Land mines are now uncommon.[/p][/*][*][p]Landmines damage from 200 to 300.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of drones, you can find friendly spiders in chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of land mines, you can find reload cells in chests.[/p][/*][*][p]The consumer class now starts with 3 friendly spiders instead of 9 drones.[/p][/*][*][p]The energizer class now starts with 2 reload cells instead of 1 armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced guardian drones with saw drones.[/p][/*][*][p]Energy sword is now legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now throw consumables through player structures.[/p][list][*][p]This means weapons, consumables, and turrets all act the same way when trying to shoot through walls, drones, or turrets.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Venom pistol bullets now last 20 seconds instead of 3 seconds.[/p][list][*][p]Venom pistol energy costs from 2 to 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Venom bullets are bouncier.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Flamethrower damage from 3 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Flamethrower knockback from 5 to 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Flamethrower flame range + 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Smart gun now deals 10 damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart gun fires twice as quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart gun now costs 1 energy to fire per bullet.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart gun knock back reduced from 9 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Swarm Worm Gun now scales on weapon damage rather than consumable damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Swarm worms now last 4.7 seconds instead of 3.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Swarm worm gun energy cost from 1.5 to 1.8.[/p][/*][*][p]Swarm worm attack rate increased by 33%.[/p][/*][*][p]Swarm worm sight range from 8 to 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Energizer turret energy give rate reduced to 90 (was 120).[/p][/*][*][p]Bulb turrets can now grab dirt.[/p][/*][*][p]The drill can now appear at crafters after being unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]The drill now deals 30 damage 10 times per second at extremely close range.[/p][list][*][p](This is about 8 times the DPS of the battery gun)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mortar turrets now have grabbing legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser turrets now have grabbing legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Mining in the [b]fungus biome[/b] now causes extra dirt to recede away.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]“Can’t Afford” Pop up no longer blocks shop costs.[/p][/*][*][p]Ships can now break dirt through items. (Items used to block your ship from mining dirt).[/p][/*][*][p]Drones will now make frogs angry at you.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now saves your selected mining tool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused stat booster machines in the pit city to not reset their costs between runs.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Renamed “Burrow Core” to “Burrow Turret”.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now remains paused while dragging an item out of the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Drill description improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Want to support More?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/humanyoyo"]Follow Humanyoyo [/url]and all our social media listed on the Steam page to stay updated on events, launch news, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/rmbsr9nMn4"]Discord [/url]to give more detailed feedback about the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Share the game to your favorite content creators and friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Post any screenshots or gameplay recordings to show off your skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57572/CleanFall_Supporter_Pack/"]Supporter Pack[/url]. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks everyone- I hope you guys enjoy the new stuff.[/p][p][/p][p]Humanyoyo and his marketing folks[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44828270/4aa2f47bb88084dfbe8b7b6d55665fd7be490867.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: CleanFall EA Hotfix #2-bug fixes & optimizations and what I am working on
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, here’s another quick patch. I was planning on waiting a few more days to push, but there were a couple of larger problems that needed to be addressed quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]As the whirlwind of launch slows down, updates will become a little sparser as I focus on expanding the game’s content while fixing some of the more complex issues in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]I will also be working on a roadmap for CleanFall’s early access, so there’s that to look forward to.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here are the patch notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Your language selection is now saved when quitting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now saves your selected difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pathfinder cooldown UI alignment for some resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused armor to not work after entering chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Armor can now stack and be dropped.[/p][list][*][p]Armor’s cost has been increased to 1 ore and 3 fiber.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the alchemy UI to disappear after closing the alchemy display in the Reaper’s palace.[/p][/*][*][p]Burrow core lasers no longer appear with infinite range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the end of the game to be blocked off by dirt.[/p][list][*][p](This was a nightmare to fix).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Buzz Saws now stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Max Clearer range increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that enabled walls to be alchemized before unlocking alchemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would make wall beams invisible if the player alchemized a wall within 0.2 seconds of placing it.[/p][/*][*][p]The grappler can now grab items.[/p][/*][*][p]The grappler can now extend up to 60% above its max range before snapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Repulse is 16% stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a mobility tool strength upgrade would not display it’s increase amount in Japanese.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the game to restart the tutorial when quitting the game during a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where recycle meteors would not take damage when latched onto by a turret.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What I’m working on:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Save load system[/p][list][*][p]While I am unable to add saving during the middle of a section, I can add saving at the start of a new chapter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Smart gun rework[/p][list][*][p]I hear ya folks. We don’t like the smart gun![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Class update[/p][/*][*][p]Nightmare mode (lower priority after seeing community reception)[/p][/*][*][p]Many more bug fixes and optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the interest and feedback! It’s very helpful for knowing where to go with development.[/p][p][/p][p]-humanyoyo[/p][p]                  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/4aa2f47bb88084dfbe8b7b6d55665fd7be490867.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CleanFall EA Update#1 New Modes, Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Salutations denizens of the abyss![/p][p]     We’ve just rolled out a fresh update for [i]CleanFall[/i], and it’s packed with new ways to play, quality-of-life upgrades, and important fixes. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]New Modes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Casual Mode-An easier version of cleanfall well suited for casual players.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Vibe Mode-A mode that removes monster invasions so players can build, experiment, and explore the world at their own pace[/p][/*][/list][p](Side note: The intended CleanFall experience version will be renamed as Normal Mode, we strongly recommend you try the Normal Mode first)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/d0eaf73771326450d9031eb79e5d0ad1a359444a.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Improvements & Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an arrow to the structure deconstruction tutorial to help better show where to put your cursor.[/p][/*][*][p]The yellow fungus section has been slightly reworked. Getting through the fungus barrier should be easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropping items now drops the entire stack instead of 1 item.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets can now be placed through other objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Items last longer on the ground after being dropped.[/p][/*][*][p]When turrets are placed, they now float for a moment to help increase the accuracy of placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets now cling to objects more tightly, improving ship stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an arrow that alerts you when you have unlocked a new room.[/p][/*][*][p]Glow corn can now be harvested without waiting for the player to gather it.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer alchemize turrets before you discover the unlock. (I feel like being able to accidentally alchemize turrets was just confusing instead of helpful).[/p][/*][*][p]Buzz saws now properly get larger with more turret range.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the turret grabber to not move grabber-type turrets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause the game to freeze when dying with the weapon wheel open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the weapon wheel would be too small on certain resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the velocity blade to hurt player structures.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that stopped players from harvesting glow corn when they had a full inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Buzz saws now properly get larger with more turret range.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3][b]Want to support More?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/humanyoyo"]Follow Humanyoyo [/url]and all our social media listed on the Steam page to stay updated on events, launch news, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/rmbsr9nMn4"]Discord [/url]to give more detailed feedback about the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Share the game to your favorite content creators and friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Post any screenshots or gameplay recordings to show off your skills. [/p][/*][*][p]Purchase the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57572/CleanFall_Supporter_Pack/"]Supporter Pack[/url]. (I'm quite proud of the game's soundtrack)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57572/CleanFall_Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Ohh, one last thing, we are bundling with these cool games and you can enjoy [b]an extra 10% off[/b] by buying these bundles:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57574/CleanFallPrimordialis/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57613/CleanFall__20_Minutes_Till_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58103/CleanFall__Comet_Rogue__mining_roguelikes/"][/dynamiclink] Thank you again for your incredible support![/p][p]Humanyoyo[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/4aa2f47bb88084dfbe8b7b6d55665fd7be490867.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update & CleanFall Launch Date！
notes.content:
[p]Salutations denizens of the abyss! After almost three years of hard work, I am happy to announce that CleanFall’s early access will launch on [b]August 8th at 8:00 am EDT[/b]! The launch price will be announced soon. If you have any feedback or suggestions regarding the pricing, please feel free to leave a comment.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BWoL9GdhaMo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Before that, however, there will be another update to CleanFall’s demo. I have gotten so much feedback from players, and I have been listening closely. Here’s what you can expect in the most recent update:[/p][p][/p][h2]1) New, cleaned up UI elements[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/ab08b4826b8ecfb37636339514697a0812d9e214.png"][/img]Upgrade machines have gotten a reskin. The alchemy recipe viewer now displays a tree of recipes showing how recipes build toward one another. Shops have a proper UI.[/p][p][/p][h2]2) A new jet pack for the consumer class[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/da085a56e3be47dbf2617f9e9426ad75ea0509b4.gif"][/img][/h2][p]Several players have complained that vertical traversal can be frustrating. I agree. The consumer class now comes equipped with a jet pack to aid players who want to ascend the caverns and abyss.[/p][p][/p][h2]3) Ship building in chapter 1[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/d8f91a515af359ff13ea2ea9d33e2209c214db04.png"][/img]I've shown off ship building in marketing material and the trailer. However, it was very difficult to actually pull it off in chapter 1. Now, the technomancer class is equipped with three thrusters, and we have a new ship building tip system.[/p][p][/p][h2]4) Many balance changes (Flame Thrower viable again!)[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/929e17153d4114f1e1ab0bd246da158b48c9143e.gif"][/img][/h2][p]CleanFall's balance is exceptionally important to me. I want all classes to be viable. For example, the flame thrower now repels creatures and creates a great deal of thrust that players can leverage.[/p][p][/p][h2]5) A map of the entire underground...[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/d66014ef91054206af9394aa608d526169fb7602.png"][/img]We now have a map in the Reaper's Palace that can give players a general idea of what lies deeper in the planet...[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone for the continued support! I will also be offering a sound track available for purchase for those who want to support me further.  Keep giving me feedback as well- I read everything, and it seriously helps me hone in the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Want to help even more?[/b][/p][p]Try out the demo and leave us feedback in a review, or hit the “Follow” and “Add to your wishlist” buttons on[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2769780/CleanFall/"] [b]the CleanFall page.[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again,[/p][p]Humanyoyo
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828270/4aa2f47bb88084dfbe8b7b6d55665fd7be490867.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CleanFall Demo Update for Indie Live Expo 2025 & Lovecraftian Days 2025!
notes.content:
Hey Cleaners!

CleanFall is part of[b] Indie Live Expo[/b] and the [b]Lovecraftian Days 2025[/b] on Steam now!

To celebrate, we’ve been working hard on a major demo update, shaped by all the incredible feedback we received during Steam Next Fest in Feb.

   [b]Here are what’s new in the update:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Big improvements to ship building and important vending machines should be easier to find.
[*]  Obelisks now cost 3 ore and increase the difficulty of the game, and the world is significantly less dangerous on day 2 and 3.
[*]  All turrets are much lighter for better game experience.
[*]  Walls have been completely fixed- no more random breaks.
[*]  Floating objects now have locked rotation, allowing stable building.
[*]  The new propellor turret allows you to lock your ship’s rotation and hold your ship steady. Pressing up or down will cause the propeller to ascend or descend.
[*]  Recycle turrets have been reworked.
[*]  Many perks have been reworked for balance.
[*]  Revamped tutorial.
[*]  The pulse rifle no longer kills any creatures.
[*]  New class selection system (Energizer, Consumer, Technomancer), and rebalanced perks.
[*]  More ore, better fiber drop rates, new energy plants, turret crafters, and more.
[*]  New weapon wheel – hold TAB to pause and switch items more easily.
[*]  7 new sound effects, bug fixes, and polish all around.
[/list]

We can’t wait for you to try it — and as always, your feedback helps a ton. You can leave your feedback in a steam review or join our Discord to submit your feedback.

Happy spelunking,
Humanyoyo

notes.title: CleanFall Steam Next Fest Update,Community Feedback and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!
    Steam Next Fest is here, and we’ve been hard at work making CleanFall even better. Thanks to your feedback, we’re rolling out exciting new features, weapons, and gameplay improvements. 


🔹 [b]New Feature: Quick Attack Button[/b]

It can be challenging navigating inventory slots. So we’ve designed a new, helpful tool. Just press R to instantly use your best consumable—no more scrolling in the middle of a fight! You’ll see the new feature in the bottom left hand corner of the game. 

🔹 [b]New Feature: Turret Physics and Mobile Base Building
[/b]
Turrets now latch onto objects in the world with real-time physics. They’ll droop, pull, float, re-attach, etc. Creative players may even connect them to floating objects in the game, thereby creating mobile bases bristling with gun turrets! This opens up all kinds of tactical ideas.

🔹 [b]Future Plans: Upgrade Machines, Chapter Progression and Advanced “Ship” Building[/b]

CleanFall is ultimately going to be three chapters in length. Each chapter will present wildly new biomes and creatures, requiring extraordinary tactics for survival. 

Since replayability and roguelite depth is highly valued, the chapters are going to combine into a diverse, multi-faceted experience that rewards different builds and play styles. Character upgrade machines will become a part of all three chapters, allowing players to carefully curate abilities. Perks will continue to expand in fresh new ways. Exotic weapons and items will become more plentiful. The story will have astonishing twists and turns.

And, yes, “ship” building is going to play an important role in chapter 2. Not only will you have to build a war machine that can withstand brutal attacks, but you’re going to have to fly it into the deep—into what is known as “The Hollow” and “The Abyss.” 

And, perhaps, your ship will be partially composed of nests… allowing you to use creatures to fight for you.

[b]Steam Next Fest Patch Notes [/b]

🔹  [b]New Additions[/b]
	•	Turrets now shoot out gripping legs, allowing them to attach to monsters, terrain, or other turrets for creative tactical advantages.
	•	Bulb turrets now act as anchors for ship-building.
	•	New floaty objects scattered around the world to help you construct makeshift ships.
	•	Boom Spore orbs now explode on impact.
	•	New “Recycle Turret” unleashes swarms of worms at enemies.
	•	Autonomous helper turrets spawn in rubble to aid players for free.

🔹  [b]New Weapons[/b]
	•	Venom Pistol – Poison your enemies with each shot.
	•	Needle Gun – Fires high-speed projectiles with pinpoint accuracy.
	•	Energy Sword – Slash through enemies with devastating plasma arcs.
	•	Drone Launcher – Deploy attack drones for airborne strikes.
	•	Swarm Worm Gun – Release hordes of worms on unsuspecting foes.
	•	Smart Gun – Tracks and fires at enemies automatically.

🔹 [b] Tweaks & Balancing[/b]
	•	Frogs’ health reduced, making early encounters smoother.
	•	Flamethrower has reduced range & damage but consumes less than half its previous energy.
	•	Battery Gun now fires faster & costs half the energy—shoot downward to fly!
	•	Player movement & climbing improvements – Faster response, smoother terrain navigation.
	•	New sound effects for turrets, explosions, and gunfire.

[b] How You Can Help[/b]
💾 Wishlist CleanFall on Steam – It’s the best way to support us & stay updated.

📢 Spread the Word – Tell your friends, share gameplay clips, and post your craziest builds!
💬 Give Us Feedback – Join our [url=https://discord.gg/xhHyZqxnKy]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!
🖊️[url=https://forms.gle/DPYHwCf7qFxT46fFA]Fill out the form [/url]to have a chance to get early access to future updates

 CleanFall is evolving fast, and we can’t wait to see how you use these new tools to conquer the depths. See you in Steam Next Fest! 🎮

notes.title: Public Demo Now Available until August 6th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This last month has been filled with tedious bug fixes, tweaks to the game's balance, and a shiny new Chinese translation of the game. With this last month of work, the game's public demo is now ready to be played! [b]Please note: the public demo until August 6th,2024![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130820/CleanFall_Demo/

If you want to get in touch, feel free to join the discord. I encourage everyone to make suggestions and to share the shenanigans they discover. The Discord also offers a way to report bugs that may crop up.

for those who are interested, here's a list of all the various changes and fixes in patch 0.6.2.2:

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Guardian drone now costs 3 ore and 5 monster fibers. (was 4 ore, 4 fiber)
[*]Vine wake boots now cost 6 monster fibers. (was 3 ore, 3 fiber)
[*]Generators now cost 9 monster fibers. (was 3 ore, 3 fiber)
[*]Auto Pusher is now 1 ore and 6 monster fiber. (was 3 ore, 4 fiber)
[*]Drone Factory is now 2 ore and 9 monster fiber. (was 6 ore, 6 fiber)
[*]Spare Scrap perk now reduces turret damage by 15% instead of reducing permanent weapon damage.
[*]Mole Mode perk: pathfinder cooldown from 100% to 60%. (Buff)
[*]The illusion of Freedom perk: changed negative to reduce structure HP by 20%.
[*]Explosive Organs perk: light radius negative from 70% to 60%. (Buff)
[*]Drones come in packs of 3 instead of 2.
[*]Slightly fewer boss Var on second night.
[*]Day is now 10 seconds longer.
[*]Day 2 ecosystem slightly calmer.
[*]Drone factory energy consumption reduce to 20 (from 30)
[*]Bulb turret damage to 30 (from 10).
[*]Slightly increased ore spawn rate.
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 1 Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Slightly shifted Shop’s colliders (fixed clipping).
[*]Chests now place invulnerable ground below themselves.
[*]Upgrade machines no longer spawn in the demo.
[list]
[*]Upgrade machines make no contextual sense without the rest of the game. In the full game, reaching the second chapter for the first time will retroactively cause upgrade machines to spawn in chapter 1
[/list][*]Dragons no longer heal after entering their nests.
[*]Dragons stay inside their nest longer.
[*]Intro sign first message tweaked.
[*]Snail Shop entrance emits a small glow.
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Renamed “non-consumable damage” to “permanent weapon damage”.
[*]Increased pathfinder tutorial popup duration.
[*]Pulse Rifle primary fire physics of been reworked.
[*]Upwards pulse is consistent and easy to use.
[*]There is a new tech involved with horizontal pulses. If no horizontal movement keys are pressed and [*]the player is not touching the ground, the player’s velocity is maintained after the pulse.
[*]Passive items are now automatically placed at the top of your inventory.
[*]Items slots are now colored according to their type.
[*]Passive items are green
[*]Consumable weapons are red
[*]Turrets are blue
[*]Permanent Weapons are Yellow
[*]Added new tips.
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[*]Time jingles is now effected by audio sliders.
[*]You can no longer scroll your inventory while in the pause menu.
[*]Loud death audio bug fixed.
[*]Hornet wings flapping is now effected by audio sliders.
[*]Jungle Demon spawn is now effected by audio sliders.
[*]Turret rotation audio is now effected by audio sliders.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused crafters to hum insanely loudly even when sound is turned down.
[*]Trying to move items while in pathfinder no longer causes inventory to break.
[*]Throwing an item right before interacting with an object no longer causes throw animation to loop [*]endlessly.
[*]Fixed a bug where restarting the game would cause certain objects in the hub area to move to strange locations.
[*]Fixed bug that caused centipede nests to not spawn centipedes.
[*]Leech Cavern buildings can no longer overlap with the door.
[*]Fixed Hotkeys all defaulting to first slot when reloading or opening options menu.
[*]Patched in the hole found on the right edge of the map.
[*]Wings no longer randomly appear if the player spams jump in tight quarters.
[*]Camp sites and the snail shop no longer boost the music volume after using them.
[*]Fixed a bug that made the music for the final wave of the leech cavern very loud.
[*]Nukes now properly kill multiple enemies.
[*]Moving items while in ghost state no longer causes inventory to break.
[*]Players can no longer break into the shop as a ghost.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused time to progress while in the snail shop.
[*]Fire from flamethrowers and flame turrets now produces light properly.
[*]Turrets no longer attack land mines.
[*]Player can no longer infinitely wall jump in front of start manor.
[*]Top of the map in chapter 1 is now properly filled in.
[*]Walls are now properly categorized as turrets.
[*]Dying while in pathfinder no longer breaks the game.
[*]Alphas no longer cause music to randomly disappear in blood biome.
[*]Mining line now disappears if player dies or uses f-tool during its animation.
[*]Dying while throwing item no longer causes the animation to get stuck looping.
[/list]

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: New Beginnings | Devlog 0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-0kx7Xnb-LY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey folks! I decided it's about time I give an update about what development has looked like. In the future, dev logs will have a lot more details, but I needed to keep this one very brief due to the large quantity of material I need to cover.

[h3]Updates that Didn't Make It into the Video[/h3]
[list]
[*]Perks that provide buffs with negative side effects
[*]16 unique monster to inhabit Chapter 1
[*]Energy Update - energy is focused on production and cost rather than quantity
[*]Story Content and dialogues
[*]Unlockable Rooms that provide buffs to the player
[*]Huft Biome
[*]Special items that spawn in the Snail Shop
[*]Large item update that made over 20 items available in Chapter 1
[*]Various bug fixes and refinements
[/list]

Thanks for following development, and stayed tuned for future updates!
